fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that agents of a loan application allegedly contacted the complainant and relatives with abusive messages over alleged dues of Rs. 50,000. The matter was brought to Vellore North PS on 2025-05-19, while the incident was placed on 2025-05-19 at roughly 21:00. The online submission was made by Dharani Gopal (9000000072). Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100074. Pavithra Bai (9000000006) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. Potentially relevant material referenced includes social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Messages reportedly sent to relatives to pressure repayment.
fields.Keywords: loan app, harassment, receiving account, witness, screenshot, night, main street
